model: MC Series drives MC1000 / MC3000 (Modbus RTU)
applies_to: Lenze AC Tech MC1000 and MC3000 Series drives, software 213-083 rev 13 (parameter configurations 188-190); reference guide RG-MCMOD.
summary: The MC1000/MC3000 are Lenze AC Tech drives with a Modbus RTU slave at a fixed 9600 baud. Registers #1-#50 hold the control word, keypad speed command, status bytes (load, run status, direction, source, fault), motor voltage, run time and PID values; programming parameter n sits at register n + 51.

addressing.note: Lenze numbers by AC Tech register #, which is the address sent on the wire (Modbus 4X/3X numbers are one larger). The frame examples confirm it: #24 is read at start address 0x0018. Programming parameter n = register n + 51.

source.title: MC Series Drives Modbus Communications Reference Guide
source.pages: pp. 3-18 (protocol, setup, control registers and status tables), pp. 20+ (parameter list)

notes: Host: copy hosted by Precision Electric (a Lenze AC Tech distributor); no copy was found on lenze.com.

Left out: command speed #24 and actual speed #25. Table 6 prints 0.1 Hz (0-2400), while the data-type table and notes 3a/3b say hundredths of a Hz (0x0201 = 5.13 Hz); the guide contradicts itself. #24 can still be read as a 6-register block starting at address 24.

Operational status (low byte #26): 0 fault lockout, 1 fault, 2 start pending, 3 stop, 4 DC brake, 5 run at 0 Hz, 6 run, 7 accel, 8 decel, 9 current limit, 10 decel override, 11 lower transistors switching on, 12 sleep.

Speed source (high byte #28): 0 keypad, 1 0-10 VDC, 2 4-20 mA, 3-6 preset 1-4, 7 MOP, 8 reserved, 9 keypad speed (PID enabled), 10 PID keypad setpoint, 11 0-10 VDC PID setpoint, 12 4-20 mA PID setpoint.
No kWh registers are listed for the MC Series. Only the control registers and serial-setup parameters are included here.

Present fault (high byte #29): 0 none, 1 output transistor, 3 high DC bus, 4 high drive temperature, 5 thermal overload, 7 low DC bus, 9 DC brake error, 10 follower loss, 11 dynamic brake overload, 12 power sag, 13 control, 14 language, 15 external, 16 internal 16, 17 power transient, 18-23 internal errors (2, 6 and 8 reserved).
P30 CONTROL: MC1000 0 local (default), 1 remote, 2 both; MC3000 0 local (default), 1 remote, 2 serial, 3 keypad, 4 TB strip, 5 keypad 2.

integration.summary: Set P57 and P58 on the keypad. Read #26-#29 (or the 6-register block at #24) for load, status, mode, source and fault. To control: write the password (default 19) to #48, send 0200h to #1 for manual mode, start/stop via #1 and write the speed to #40.
integration.enable: P57 SERIAL LINK = 01 (with 10 s watchdog) or 02 (without); P58 = address; P30 CONTROL usually LOCAL on MC1000 and SERIAL on MC3000 for serial use.
integration.watchdog: Fixed 10 s once #48 or #49 has unlocked the drive and P57 = with timer; in LOCAL/KEYPAD 2 control the drive stops on time-out (no fault is logged).
quirks: Read one register at a time except the #24 six-word block.
FC16 accepts a single register only; FC03 and FC04 are identical.
setup: Fixed 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 2 stop bits.
gotchas: Changing CONTROL from LOCAL to REMOTE stops the drive immediately.
End a session by writing 2 to #1 (lock security).

registers.name: Drive control
registers.description: One bit per write: 0004h stop, 0008h start, 0200h manual mode, 0002h lock.

registers.name: Drive size code
registers.description: HP / voltage code (table 9 of the guide).

registers.name: Load (high byte) / operational status (low byte)
registers.description: High byte = % of full load. Low byte = status code, see notes.

registers.name: Actual direction (high) / control mode (low)
registers.description: High: 0 fwd, 1 rev. Low: 0 local, 1 remote, 2 serial.

registers.name: Speed source (high) / speed reference (low)
registers.description: High: speed source code (notes). Low: 0 auto, 1 manual.

registers.name: Present fault (high) / commanded direction (low)
registers.description: High byte = fault code. Low: 0 fwd, 1 rev.

registers.name: Motor voltage
registers.description: Effective output voltage to the motor, 0-999 V.

registers.name: PID setpoint
registers.description: MC1000 with PID and MC3000. Internal units 0-32736 over the feedback range.

registers.name: PID feedback
registers.description: MC1000 with PID and MC3000. Internal units 0-32736 over the feedback range.

registers.name: Keypad speed command
registers.description: 0-65000; drive must be in manual mode (0200h to #1).

registers.name: Local PID command
registers.description: MC1000 with PID and MC3000. Internal units 0-32736 over the feedback range.

registers.name: Unlock commands
registers.description: 0 unlocks control; the password (default 19) also unlocks parameters.

registers.name: Register version
registers.description: Parameter configuration 188, 189 or 190 for software 213-083 rev 13.

registers.name: P30 control
registers.description: MC1000: 0 local, 1 remote, 2 both. MC3000 adds 2 serial, 3-5 (see notes).

registers.name: P58 serial address
registers.description: 1-247 (default 30). Set before using the serial link; avoid address 1.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
